name: honey-bee
description: Windows Unity Workspace provider using Git worktrees and Library-only CoW.

scripts.package:release: corepack pnpm --filter honeybee-cli package:smoke && corepack pnpm --filter honeybee-desktop package:smoke
scripts.verify: corepack pnpm security:scan && corepack pnpm licenses:check && corepack pnpm format:check && corepack pnpm lint && corepack pnpm typecheck && corepack pnpm build && corepack pnpm test:run && corepack pnpm deps:check
scripts.test:run: vitest run && corepack pnpm test:storage-host && corepack pnpm test:launcher && corepack pnpm test:setup && corepack pnpm test:update && corepack pnpm test:update-trust && corepack pnpm test:application-repair && corepack pnpm test:release-key && corepack pnpm test:combined-update && corepack pnpm test:qualification-flow
scripts.test:launcher: go -C tools/honeybee-launcher test ./... && go -C tools/honeybee-launcher vet ./...
scripts.test:update-admission: node node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc -p packages/core/tsconfig.build.json && node node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc -p apps/desktop/tsconfig.main.build.json && node --test scripts/update/combined-admission.test.mjs scripts/update/desktop-session.test.mjs
scripts.test:update: go -C tools/honeybee-update-package test ./... && go -C tools/honeybee-update-package vet ./... && node scripts/update/build-package-tool.mjs && node node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc -p packages/core/tsconfig.build.json && node node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc -p apps/desktop/tsconfig.main.build.json && node --test scripts/update/desktop-session.test.mjs scripts/update/desktop-update-lifecycle.test.mjs scripts/update/application-activity.test.mjs scripts/update/stage-release.test.mjs scripts/update/prepare-release.test.mjs scripts/update/update-plan.test.mjs scripts/update/update-transaction.test.mjs scripts/update/app-activation.test.mjs scripts/update/publish-version.test.mjs scripts/update/published-update.test.mjs scripts/update/version-health.test.mjs scripts/update/doctor-job.test.mjs scripts/qualification/qa-registry.test.mjs scripts/update/application-activity.test.mjs scripts/qualification/preservation.test.mjs
